title: Adopting themakR
text: package may keep distinct accent (example, border colour hex) sharing everything else. Set bslib’s primary _pkgdown.yml: _pkgdown.yml merged themakR’s, wins site . Links, active navbar item, focus rings, blockquote bars follow new accent automatically; fonts, toggle, footer, layout stay shared. (Dark-mode link colour stays Hugo Coder blue unless also override CSS — accents read well #fafafa #212121 work best.)
code: template:   package: themakR   bslib:     primary: "#5E2C8E"   # your package's accent (here: the suite purple)

themakR 0.1.0
text: Initial release: shared pkgdown template CTTIR suite. Hugo Coder palette (light #fafafa, dark #212121, blue link accent) pkgdown’s native light/dark/auto switch. rotemplate-style navbar (hex + brand far left, Search · Reference · Articles · Changelog · GitHub · toggle right) home sidebar (Links · License · Community · Citation · Developers · R-universe). Inter body/heading font, JetBrains Mono code font. Shared suite footer per-package part_of wording override. Per-package accent override via template.bslib.primary.
